text:
sara: Quick sync — planning a small canary flip for multi-region failover. Goal: EU sessions fallback to US model-v2 when capacity constrained. Canary 5%, sticky routing by session, 30m smoke window. Target start 10:30 UTC. @devon @mike @kevin any blockers?

devon: Which feature flag are you toggling exactly? route.failover.multi-region? Also confirm stickiness type (session vs ip).

kevin: Yes, route.failover.multi-region -> enable true + canary 5. Stickiness: session (session_id cookie). Model target: fallback-model:v2. KV cache TTL = 900s. Watch cache miss rate.

mike: Oncall heads-up. I'll monitor latency SLOs and 5xx. Can you paste the exact CLI you plan to run and the rollback steps?

sara: Sure — commands:```
redwood feature set route.failover.multi-region \--regions EU,US \--model fallback-model:v2 \--enable true \--canary 5 \--stickiness session \--ttl 900
```Rollback: set --canary 0 or --enable false. Runbook: <https://runbook.internal/rb-multi-region-failover>

devon: Want a guardrail: auto-disable if 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR p50_latency increase > 50ms for 3m window. Can we wire circuit-breaker?

kevin: Yeah we can. Policy service snippet:```
policy apply \--target route.failover.multi-region \--on-5xx 0.005 \--on-latency 50 \--window 180
```That will flip canary to 0 and notify #incidents.

sara: OK scheduling 10:30 UTC. Request explicit ack from oncall + infra. Also will post to #announcements for EU customers.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll pin Grafana dashboards and create alerts: latency p50/p95 and 5xx rate. Link will be posted before start.

devon: Note on stickiness: session-based affinity means user may remain routed to US for cookie TTL. Recommend cookie TTL <= 1h and tag sessions with origin region so we can evict if needed. Also prewarm cache in US for top prefixes to avoid initial spike.

kevin: Adding prewarm job:```
jobs create prewarm \--targets top-prefixes \--region US \--duration 10m
```Also setting KV prefetch for top 50 prefixes.

sara: Approvals: @mike ack, @kevin ack, @devon ack. If all acked I'll proceed and post live updates here.

mike: ack

kevin: ack

devon: ack

sara: Starting canary at 10:30 UTC. Will update at +5m, +15m, +30m. If any regression, rollback immediately and ping #incidents.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for route.failover.multi-region (canary=5%).

sara: +12m update: health looks good so far — 5xx = 0.03%, p50 latency +12ms, p95 unchanged. Continuing to monitor.

mike: Watching logs and traces, no elevated error clusters.

kevin: Prewarm completed, cache miss rate within expected range.

sara: +30m: Canary succeeded, promoting to gradual ramp (20% over 1h). Will keep guardrails active. Closing this thread and posting summary to #announcements.
